statement: 从现在的视角里面可以看到，T短是向上接到M3,B段是向下接到M1,同时T和B之间还有一个从M2接到M3的接口。从现在的这个角度来说，我们只能看全向从M2到M3的接口，因为有V2可以判断，但是从M1接到M2的接口需要从M1的V1的位置进行判断
scope: corrected gate long M2 T/B layer destinations and existence of additional interior V2; lower-layer via evidence direction

inspection_rule.M1_to_M2: inspect V1 in M1 then locate covering M2 with validated local correspondence
inspection_rule.M2_to_M3: inspect V2 in M2 then locate covering M3 with validated local correspondence
inspection_rule.coverage: inventory whole selected conductor span, not only endpoints
inspection_rule.no_via_visible_on_M2: does not prove absence of M1 V1 under that M2

limits: layer destinations confirmed, exact destination conductors and pixels not yet assigned
do not assign nearby side tabs to selected M2 solely from proximity
additional interior V2 existence does not select a nearby coordinate automatically
